Reference / locale/collation

locale/collation#

Sorting text as a language does (Unicode Collation Algorithm, CLDR tailorings).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let a = CollatedString(origin: "Äpfel", locale: Locale("de"), options: options);
let b = CollatedString(origin: "Zebra", locale: Locale("de"), options: options);
a.order(b);                                     // less
CollatedString(origin: "item 10", locale: en, options: CollationOptions(
    strength: CollationStrength.tertiary, case_first: CollationCaseFirst.locale_default,
    numeric: true, normalization: true));      // "item 2" < "item 10"

Description#

Sorting text as a language does (Unicode Collation Algorithm, CLDR tailorings).

Strings collated with different locales or options are IncompatibleCollation. key() gives bytes that sort the same way, for an index.

Collation runs on the pinned ICU 76.1 library (tools/build-icu-collation.sh, or OKKAMA_ICU_LIBDIR); without it, CollatedString is UnavailableCollation.
